question: In a certain code language, 'HOCKEY' is written as 'BNGXDJ' and 'BOXING' is written as 'WNAFMH'. How will 'SPORTS' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

** The alphabets are decreased to 1 positional value.

 First & third and fourth & sixth alphabets are interchanged.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/584503145b0cb8f34ed34b4d82ba71e8f48d5aa95121d788f5ab37e4e5963e2d.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6fa3ba1db9062a87a1db08999db90ffdc35fc11793e3286b5f401f3872746d4.png]
